title: EnvironmentNode
description:
A managed environment instance (a "node") as reported by the node-management
surface. Substrate-agnostic: a Railway service, a Docker container, a k8s pod.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601) when the substrate exposes it.

id.description: Substrate-native id (railway service id, container id, ...).

image.description: Image / impl ref backing the node, when known.

orphan.description: True when the node has no live owning run (a reap candidate).

run_id.description: The animus run id this node serves, when recoverable.

state.description:
Lifecycle state as the substrate reports it (`SUCCESS`, `FAILED`,
`CRASHED`, `unknown`, ...).
